title: Estimating Demand for Subscription Products: Identification of Willingness to Pay Without Price Variation
eligible_reason: Structural identification of willingness to pay for a music-streaming subscription from usage and subscription choices without price variation (usage model plus probit subscription model, EM and bootstrap). No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: estimation.R: usage-equation estimation, residualized mu_hat, probit S ~ I(log(L_hat) - log(price)) + Age + Female + mustar_hat; WTP and elasticity calculations.
data_files_note: data.rds (lists dsub and duse) shipped for Section 6; readme states no disguising.
data_provenance_note: Shipped consumer-level usage and subscription data; no statement of alteration.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
